description: "Judith Shakespeare: Her Love Affairs and Other Adventures" by William Black is a historical novel written in the late 19th century. The story revolves around Judith, the spirited daughter of the famous playwright William Shakespeare, and her forays into love, magic, and the expectations of society during her time.
